subject.title: crons: /api/milanuncios-responder agota la carga de mensajes pendientes

question: Should the remaining Milanuncios pending-load work pursue guarded pagination/batching against the private `ObtenerMensajes` interface, or should the current clean-deferral behavior be treated as the intended response to provider slowness?
rationale: The code already implements retries and safe deferral; the remaining path depends on operational tolerance and whether maintainers want to rely on undocumented Milanuncios pagination fields.

options.title: Investigate guarded batching
options.body: Prove `vermas` or date filters against real Milanuncios behavior, then implement bounded pagination or reduced volume with recovery logs.

options.title: Accept clean deferral
options.body: Keep the current no-archive deferral behavior and adjust watcher thresholds/runbooks so repeated provider slowness is tracked separately from a code bug.

options.title: Escalate partner API
options.body: Pause code changes and seek a Milanuncios partner/API contract before expanding private-interface automation.

recommendation.title: Investigate guarded batching
recommendation.body: Prove `vermas` or date filters against real Milanuncios behavior, then implement bounded pagination or reduced volume with recovery logs.
